test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: If the simple Interest for 5 years is equal to 25% of the principal, then the Interest will be equal to the principal after ______ years.
solution:
**Given:**

Simple interest (S.I) = 25% × Principal

Time = 5 years

**Formula used:**

Simple interest (S.I) = (P × R × T)/100

Where, P = principal ; R = rate ; T = time

**Calculation:**

Simple interest (S.I) = (P × R × T)/100

⇒ 25/100 × P = (P × R × 5)/100

⇒ 25 = R × 5

⇒ R = 5%

According to the question:

Simple interest (S.I) = (P × R × T)/100

⇒ P = (P × 5 × T)/100

⇒ T = 100/5 = 20 years

**∴ The correct answer is 20 years.**
